findings.title: No @nx/enforce-module-boundaries rule (no ESLint config in the workspace)
findings.evidence: Checked eslint.config.{js,mjs,cjs,ts}, .eslintrc{,.json,.js,.cjs} in the root and in packages/devtools, apps/docs, examples/analog: none exist.
findings.fix: With only 4 projects this is optional. If wanted, add an ESLint flat config with @nx/enforce-module-boundaries and depConstraints on scope/type tags (e.g. type:app may depend on type:lib; packages/devtools depends on nothing in the workspace).

findings.title: Nx project pangular-inspector-docs has no tags
findings.evidence: apps/docs/project.json has no "tags" field; no module-boundaries rule exists.
findings.fix: Add "tags": ["type:app"] if you adopt module boundaries.

findings.title: Nx project analog-demo has no tags
findings.evidence: examples/analog/package.json has no nx.tags; no module-boundaries rule exists.
findings.fix: Add "nx": { "tags": ["type:example"] } if you adopt module boundaries.

findings.title: Nx project @pangular-inspector/devtools has no tags
findings.evidence: package.json#nx has targets but no "tags"; no module-boundaries rule exists.
findings.fix: Add "nx": { "tags": ["type:lib"] } if you adopt module boundaries.

findings.title: Nx project pangular-inspector has no tags
findings.evidence: project.json has no "tags" field and no module-boundaries rule exists.
findings.fix: Add "tags": ["type:app"] if you adopt module boundaries.

findings.title: h3 is an unused dependency of @pangular-inspector/devtools
findings.evidence:
knip: dependencies packages/devtools/package.json h3 (line 84)
No .ts/.mjs file in packages/devtools mentions h3. Its deps bring their own: @devframes/hub, @devframes/agentic and devframe each depend on h3 ^2.0.1, while this package declares h3 ^1.15.11, so users install an extra unused h3 v1.
findings.fix: Remove "h3" from packages/devtools/package.json dependencies (keep the h3 packageExtension for @analogjs/vite-plugin-nitro in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which is separate).
